rationale: A third-party child sustained bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition that the policyholder was responsible for maintaining, making this a clear premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child sustained a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm. The neighbors are pursuing medical bills under premises liability coverage. High-severity pediatric injury case requiring immediate adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
case_facts.claim_trigger: medical bills related to broken wrist
